description: Live status of a flight by its number for yesterday, today or tomorrow: departure and arrival airports, scheduled and expected times, terminal, gate and baggage belt, whether it is in the air, its last reported position, and a slashtel.com link to see it live on the map and get a free email when it is delayed and when it lands. Use it when someone asks where a flight is, whether it is delayed, or when it lands.

day.description: Day of departure, local time at the departure airport. Default today.

flight.description: Flight number with airline code, e.g. EK3, BA 286, AI161

name: get_flight_status
title: Get live flight status
